shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "fix config hooks spec status" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
